newsitem.title: USA: Capstar Broadcasting buys Alabama radio station.
newsitem.headline: Capstar Broadcasting buys Alabama radio station.

text.p: Privately-held radio broadcasting company Capstar Broadcasting Partners Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire radio station WZBQ-FM from Grant Radio Group LLC for $3.2 million.
The station, serving the Tuscaloosa, Alabama market, will be operated by Capstar subsidiary Southern Star Communications Inc, the company said.
The company said that upon completion of all announced transactions, it will have over 230 middle-market stations throughout the United States.
